content.topic: 2023 Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation

sections.title: Risk Stratification Schemes
details: Discusses new risk schemes to predict stroke and other thromboembolism in atrial fibrillation. Includes references to the ATRIA, HAS-BLED score, and GARFIELD models.
Emphasizes the importance of refining clinical tools to improve predictive accuracy for patients with atrial fibrillation.
Specific schemes like CHA2DS2-VASc and their validation in various cohorts are mentioned.

sections.title: Risk-Based Selection of Oral Anticoagulation: Balancing Risks and Benefits
details: Focuses on selecting anticoagulation therapy based on balancing stroke risk with bleeding risk.
Studies like ARISTOTLE trial and ROCKET-AF trial are referenced for outcomes and scoring systems like HAS-BLED.

sections.title: Oral Anticoagulants
details: Trends and validation in oral anticoagulation therapy are discussed.
Comparison of different therapies and their outcomes are presented.
